name: vouch
description: Vouch — an autonomous payment agent for the PayPal AI Hackathon. An AI agent that initiates and completes real purchases through PayPal-accepting merchants: creates PayPal checkout orders, captures approved orders, and runs a full autonomous purchase flow. Exposes an Express API, an A2A agent card, and a self-describing MCP server. Runs in demo mode without credentials; real PayPal sandbox payments with PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID/PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET.

skills.name: Create PayPal Order
skills.description: Agent initiates a PayPal checkout order on behalf of a buyer. Returns orderId and approvalUrl so the buyer can approve and pay.
examples: Create a $49.99 PayPal order for the AI Agent Store
Create a PayPal purchase order for $5.00

skills.name: Capture PayPal Order
skills.description: Capture an approved PayPal order to complete the purchase and transfer funds to the merchant.
examples: Complete the purchase for order ID 5XYZ1234ABCD

skills.name: Autonomous Purchase
skills.description: Full autonomous purchase flow: create a PayPal order and capture it. In demo mode the agent auto-approves and captures to show one complete purchase end-to-end.
examples: Autonomously purchase a $19.99 item from the demo merchant
Buy a $5.00 product end-to-end through PayPal

paypalClientCredentials.name: Authorization
paypalClientCredentials.description: Server uses PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID/PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET (env) for PayPal OAuth client_credentials token. Not passed by callers.

mode.demo: Simulated orders when PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID/PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET are unset
mode.sandbox: Real PayPal sandbox payments when credentials are set
